name: ballerinax/ai.ollama
description: Ollama allows you to run open-source large language models (LLMs), such as Llama 3, Mistral, and Gemma, locally.
readme:
## Overview

Ollama allows you to run open-source large language models (LLMs), such as Llama 3, Mistral, and Gemma, locally.

The Ollama connector offers APIs for connecting with locally running Ollama models, enabling the integration of advanced conversational AI and language processing capabilities into applications.

### Key Features

- Connect and interact with local Ollama Large Language Models (LLMs)
- Support for Llama 3, Mistral, Gemma, and other open-source models
- Efficient handling of local model prompts and completions
- Streamlined integration with local AI infrastructure

## Prerequisites

Ensure that your Ollama server is running locally before using this module in your Ballerina application.

## Quickstart

To use the `ai.ollama` module in your Ballerina application, update the `.bal` file as follows:

### Step 1: Import the module

Import the `ai.ollama` module.

```ballerina
import ballerinax/ai.ollama;
```

### Step 2: Intialize the Model Provider

Here's how to initialize the Model Provider:

```ballerina
import ballerina/ai;
import ballerinax/ai.ollama;

final ai:ModelProvider ollamaModel = check new ollama:ModelProvider("ollamaModelName");
```

### Step 4: Invoke chat completion

```ballerina
ai:ChatMessage[] chatMessages = [{role: "user", content: "hi"}];
ai:ChatAssistantMessage response = check ollamaModel->chat(chatMessages, tools = []);

chatMessages.push(response);
```

typeDefs.name: OllamaModelParameters
typeDefs.description:
Represents the model parameters for Ollama text generation.
These parameters control the behavior and output of the model.

fields.name: mirostat
fields.description:
Enable Mirostat sampling for controlling perplexity.  
- `0` = disabled  
- `1` = Mirostat  
- `2` = Mirostat 2.0

fields.name: mirostatEta
fields.description:
Influences how quickly the algorithm responds to feedback from the generated text.  
A lower value results in slower adjustments, while a higher value makes the model more responsive.

fields.name: mirostatTau
fields.description:
Controls the balance between coherence and diversity of the output.  
A lower value results in more focused and coherent text.

fields.name: numCtx
fields.description: Sets the size of the context window used to generate the next token.

fields.name: repeatLastN
fields.description:
Sets how far back the model should look to prevent repetition.  
- `0` = disabled  
- `-1` = num_ctx

fields.name: repeatPenalty
fields.description:
Sets how strongly to penalize repetitions.  
A higher value (e.g., `1.5`) will penalize repetitions more strongly,  
while a lower value (e.g., `0.9`) will be more lenient.

fields.name: temperature
fields.description:
Controls the creativity of the model's responses.  
A higher value makes the output more diverse, while a lower value makes it more focused.

fields.name: seed
fields.description:
Sets the random number seed for deterministic text generation.  
A specific value ensures the same output for identical prompts.

fields.name: numPredict
fields.description:
Maximum number of tokens to generate.  
`-1` allows infinite generation.

fields.name: topK
fields.description:
Controls randomness by selecting the top-k most likely next words.  
A higher value (e.g., `100`) increases diversity,  
while a lower value (e.g., `10`) makes responses more conservative.

fields.name: topP
fields.description:
Controls randomness by considering the cumulative probability of choices.  
A higher value (e.g., `0.95`) increases diversity,  
while a lower value (e.g., `0.5`) makes responses more conservative.

fields.name: minP
fields.description:
Ensures a balance between quality and variety.  
Filters out low-probability tokens relative to the highest probability token.

functions.name: chat
functions.description: Sends a chat request to the Ollama model with the given messages and tools.

parameters.name: messages
parameters.description: List of chat messages or user message

parameters.name: tools
parameters.description: Tool definitions to be used for the tool call

parameters.name: stop
parameters.description: Stop sequence to stop the completion

return.description: Function to be called, chat response or an error in-case of failures

functions.name: generate
functions.description:
Sends a chat request to the model and generates a value that belongs to the type
corresponding to the type descriptor argument.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: The prompt to use in the chat messages

parameters.name: td
parameters.description: Type descriptor specifying the expected return type format

return.description: Generates a value that belongs to the type, or an error if generation fails
